_comment: Non-secret Hermes structure only. Telegram credentials go in .env; environment variables override config fields.
_telegram_security: Set TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, TELEGRAM_USER_ID, and HERMES_TOTP_SECRET in .env. Mutations and session spawns require /auth <TOTP>; /lock is remote but unlock is host-only.
_voice: Voice notes use local whisper.cpp and ffmpeg. Change the default live with /lang he|en|auto.
_coding: Optional legacy coding sessions run in allowlisted isolated worktrees. Keep this disabled unless the host and child-process risk are explicitly accepted.
_hermes: Hermes GitHub-issue pipeline. Codex is the default write engine and runs network-off; Claude write sessions remain disabled unless explicitly enabled on a trusted host.
